title: Real inspirations
body:
In order to distinguish real inspiration from stray thoughts and the whisperings of Shaitan, wait and see
whether that inspiration recurs or not. Divine Inspiration is not going to leave you until you do it. It will come
to your heart repeatedly. Badness and wrong suggestions from the nafs and devils, stray thoughts, will not
persist. And even if evil whisperings do persist, it will become clear that they are not good by a kind of
disturbance you feel in your heart. If it is an inspiration, there is never going to be a doubt in your heart. You
will find absolute satisfaction. But if it is from the ego, your conscience will not be at rest.
01.04.1999
